_note: Measured from the deployed pipeline via eval/evaluate.py on the 70-query benchmark (19 dev / 51 test). 'current' is the real search() (TF-IDF + keyword boosts + fine-tuned semantic, w=0.7, broad-query hijack fixed). 'onnx' is the shipped uint8 per-channel ONNX encoder + design_embeddings.npy (pure semantic). 'float_checkpoint' is the same fine-tune before quantization (queryv2_phase2). 'lexical' is search() with the semantic layer disabled. 'base' is un-tuned all-MiniLM-L6-v2.

component_probes._note: 28 natural-language probes over the separate 9,735-component pool (21st.dev + skiper.ui), NOT the 950-design benchmark. 'deployed_hybrid' is search_components() (uint8 ONNX + lexical, w=0.7); 'float_checkpoint' is queryv2_phase2 pure semantic. R@5=1.0: every probe's target component is in the top 5. The two rank-2 cases are near-duplicate siblings (murmuration-boids vs -wordmark; a 21st.dev mirror of skiper89).

combined_experiment._note: Exp C (REJECTED): continued training on 950 designs + 9,735 components (10,685 pairs, 91% components). Design dev nDCG@5 fell below the 0.934 bar while component retrieval was IDENTICAL to the designs-only encoder — the query-style fine-tune already generalizes to the component prompts, so combined training diluted designs for zero component gain. Shipped encoder stays queryv2_phase2.
